summary: Overview of the CGMs that work with AAPS: links to setup pages, a table of which BG source app to use for each sensor, and which sources count as trusted (allowing SMB at all times). Bold terms in the trusted-source table are settings of the CGM apps (xDrip, Juggluco), not AAPS labels.

sections.heading: Compatible CGMs
sections.summary: Links to CGM setup pages and a table mapping each sensor to the apps that can feed it to AAPS as BG source; warns against using Nightscout as BG source.

sections.heading: Trusted BG data sources
sections.summary: Which sensor and app combinations AAPS treats as trusted, so SMB is always allowed. Terms like 'Direct, Native', 'xDrip broadcast', 'Patched Libre' and 'no calibration' are xDrip or Juggluco settings.
